headwords: xử lí ngôn ngữ tự nhiên
yêu nhiều thì ốm, ôm nhiều thì yếu

flags.why: This confuses xịu, meaning to slump with exhaustion, with xìu, which can describe a deflated tyre ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-x%E1%BB%8Bu)).
A flat tyre does not illustrate this sense of xịu.
flags.fix: Mệt quá, người nó xịu xuống. = Exhausted, he slumped.

flags.why: The example defines light instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Yếng sáng từ ngọn đèn hắt lên tường. = Light from the lamp falls on the wall.
